nodes.title: Stated selection criteria in practitioner forums, counted by segment (2025-26)
nodes.summary: Keyword+hand coding of ~6.5k comments in 59 threads (HN, Lemmy) plus 18 GH/Discourse threads. Household: ACME/auto-TLS 195/18 HN + 45/13 Lemmy, config ergonomics 146/20 + 51/11, performance 155/20, security 113/19, vendor-risk 69/18, memory 88/14, license 57/16, single-binary 14/3. Enterprise k8s: vendor-risk 31/3, config/annotations 20/4, perf 25/3, security 20/3. Agent gateways: credential isolation 93c/10t, cost 60/7, authz 46/10, supply-chain/compiled 47/12, audit 48/10. PQ 0 and formal 0 in all selection threads.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Keyword mention is not a buying criterion; enthusiast-skewed, non-random samples; Reddit/lobste.rs unreachable.
nodes.underclaim_risk: Silent majority on managed platforms (ALB, Cloudflare) never posts; enterprise buyers decide off-forum, so formal/PQ/FIPS demand could exist in procurement documents not forums.

nodes.title: PQ, formal assurance and compliance are not stated buying criteria in server/proxy selection threads
nodes.summary: 0 of ~8,175 comments in 56 selection threads state PQ as a criterion (109 PQ comments exist only in LE-PQ and NSA/ML-KEM threads, about CA/standards). Formal verification: 0 true hits in selection threads; one sarcastic reply in the formal-verification thread ('this is why one would prefer NGINX over a formally verified http server', 45566877). Memory safety is contested as 'moot out of scope contract' (49870493). Compliance (FIPS/FedRAMP/SOC2): ~0 outside agent threads. Agent hardening appears only inside agent-security product launches (145 comments, 12 threads). Probe scans of 500 recent HN comments each: 'post-quantum' 5 proxy mentions, 'ML-KEM' 1, 'formally verified' 2.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Absence in forums != absence in procurement (CNSA 2.0, FedRAMP, EU CRA are mandated top-down).
nodes.underclaim_risk: PQ is already shipped as library defaults (so nobody needs to ask); lack of mention could mean success of invisible defaults.

nodes.title: Top-5 explicit deal breakers for switching proxies/gateways
nodes.summary: (1) annotation/feature non-parity in migration; (2) behavioural default drift causing incidents; (3) open-core paywall/licence; (4) maintainer/governance continuity; (5) missing ops must-haves (graceful reload, rate limit/geo, metrics) and install-trust/benchmark-credibility backlash. Evidence: RKE2 8672, kubero 717, EG 5594, kgateway 12896, NGF 4936, Traefik forum 29602/29612/29653/29733/29829, Nine blog, Ferron 45653350, nginx ACME 44889941.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Counts per breaker are 2-12 threads; ranking by thread count, not impact.
nodes.underclaim_risk: Many switchers never post their reason.

nodes.title: Who switches first: agent-infrastructure builders, not ingress or household users
nodes.summary: H-W1: segment order (a) forced ingress-nginx migrators (adopt parity-compatible incumbents: RKE2->Traefik, Nine->HAProxy; none ask for assurance), (b) agent-infra startups (credential isolation, MCP authz, cost/audit, distrust of LiteLLM quality/vulns) - only segment with agent hardening as stated criterion, (c) household self-hosters only for <=3-line config + auto-ACME. A new server enters via (b), and must clear deal-breakers 1-5 in (a)/(c) later.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Inferred from launch-thread self-selection; no purchase data.
nodes.underclaim_risk: Enterprise regulated buyers (FIPS/FedRAMP) may switch first for compliance reasons invisible on forums.

nodes.title: Quantified cost of ingress-nginx migration: weeks, >200 Ingresses, four prod incidents
nodes.summary: Nine (Swiss SME host) migrated to haproxy-ingress 'over last few weeks' (blog 2026-10-07): 8 default differences; incidents: 504 on 55s exports (50s default vs 60s), maxconn 2000/pod, HTTP/1.0 passthrough 400 on S3 backend, bcrypt basic-auth spinlock >2 cores at 155 conns. RKE2 maintainer 2025-07: 'switching ingress controllers is a non-trivial exercise'. Brella: Traefik because migration tool allows staying on Ingress. K8s statement 2026-01-29: ingress-nginx used by about half of cloud-native environments.
nodes.underclaim_risk: Larger enterprises likely paid far more; unreported.

nodes.title: Traefik ingress-nginx compatibility layer: adoption driver and failure surface
nodes.summary: Traefik v3.7 'Langres' (2026-05-11) claims ingress-nginx drop-in, 80+ annotations; v3.7.16 current 2026-10-20. Forum: migrants chose Traefik 'due to level of nginx annotation support' (29612) but hit use-regex not working in 3.6.6 (29602), whitelist-source-range on master not released in 3.6.8 (29653), helm key rename kubernetesIngressNginx->kubernetesIngressNGINX v39->v40 (29733), dual-controller status race (29704). Migration-compat is the winning criterion and the leaking one.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Forum posts are the failures; successes are silent.
nodes.underclaim_risk: Traefik share gain likely larger than visible.

nodes.title: Paywalled features in open-source gateways trigger explicit churn threats
nodes.summary: NGINX Gateway Fabric: Prometheus request metrics only in NGINX Plus; user 2026-03-16 'leaves a bitter taste... triggers me to check for alternatives', 2026-06-11 'need metrics on open-source ASAP, otherwise we will stop using'; maintainers: 'feedback we hear quite often'. HN: Bifrost features gated; GoModel licence page debate. Reinforces licence/open-core as deal breaker 3.

nodes.title: Agent/LLM/MCP gateway buyers: credential isolation, authz, cost, audit; LiteLLM distrust
nodes.summary: 12 HN launch/discussion threads (2025-07..2026-10): credential/secret isolation 93c/10t, cost-budget 60/7, audit 48/10, authz/OAuth 46/10, sandbox 36/11, prompt-injection/guardrails 32/10, gateway's own vuln/quality 16/7. Stated: virtual keys so provider keys never reach sandbox (50145507); LiteLLM 'vibecoded slop... vulnerabilities' and a new LiteLLM vuln on HN front page same day; preference for compiled Go/Rust gateways and compile-time supply-chain control (sbproxy in 47849097); 'missing authorization for MCP servers' (45010524); oauth2proxy+istio as DIY; agentgateway user: proxy pods hold 1.4 GiB RSS after load (glibc arenas; jemalloc not default; GH 1176).
nodes.overclaim_risk: Launch threads select for topic; includes vendor self-promotion comments.
nodes.underclaim_risk: Enterprise MCP governance buyers (Stacklok survey 5% governed) are off-forum.

nodes.title: Household/self-host server choice is driven by 3-line config and auto-ACME; switching cost quoted in minutes
nodes.summary: Hand-coded ~30 first-person switch statements: config ergonomics ~10 ('3 lines of setup', 'ten minutes', 'one line with sane defaults'), ACME/internal-CA ~5, others scattered. Counterflow: users leave Caddy for Traefik/HAProxy when needing LB/rewrite/auth (4 stmts); Pangolin/Tailscale tunnels draw switchers (3). Cloudflare is the default 'security' answer in bot-flood threads (50073221, 45965060). Stated quantified cost: 10-15 minutes (Caddy).
nodes.overclaim_risk: Caddy-fan selection bias on HN Caddy thread.
nodes.underclaim_risk: Most households use NPM/Cloudflare tunnels silently.

nodes.title: Governance continuity is a stated criterion: River 'died when grant funding stopped'
nodes.summary: HN 45653865 (Ferron thread 2025-10-21): 'was waiting for River... like many grant-based projects it just died when funding stopped'. Traefik issue open since 2019 -> internal fork maintained 2 years -> HAProxy migration (45357732). Caddy maintainership thread 2025-10-15 (105c). nginx-unit bad experience -> Caddy (44889941). Extends gap.dormancy-churn with user-voice evidence.

nodes.title: Critical nginx CVEs do not produce stated switching: NGINX Rift and IngressNightmare threads
nodes.summary: CVE-2026-42945 'NGINX Rift' (NVD 2026-05-13, CVSS 9.2/8.1, heap overflow in rewrite module since 0.6.27, public PoC 2026-05-12): HN 48138268, 101 comments, 0 comments say leaving nginx, 12 about patching, long ASLR debate (one: 'lately LLM agents lowering ASLR-bypass cost'). IngressNightmare thread 43465424 (9.8, 2025-03-24): 0 switch statements. One commenter (44889941) switched to Caddy citing nginx's non-information on an HTTP/1 desync and fear of auditor questions - security+compliance as driver n=1.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Reaction in a thread != behaviour over months.
nodes.underclaim_risk: Switches after incidents happen quietly in ops teams.

nodes.title: Reddit blocks and lobste.rs PoW-walls automated research agents; Lemmy, Discourse, HN Algolia, GitHub GraphQL stay open
nodes.summary: old.reddit/www.reddit JSON return a 'Blocked' page; lobste.rs serves an Anubis proof-of-work challenge on HTML/JSON/RSS routes (a live example of PoW gate stopping an agent with plain HTTP client); GH Discussions disabled on kubernetes/ingress-nginx. Practical: forum research must use HN Algolia items API, Lemmy /api/v3 (comment pagination returned duplicates; dedupe by id), Discourse /search.json and /t/ID.json, GraphQL search(type:DISCUSSION).
nodes.overclaim_risk: Only plain-HTTP client tested; headless browser would pass Anubis.

protocol_implications: Position assurance/PQ/agent hardening as invisible defaults, not selling points: no segment states PQ or formal assurance as a criterion (grade C).
Ship a migration-parity layer early (ingress-nginx annotation translation + defaults-compatible profile): deal breakers 1 and 2; acceptance test = Nine-style 8-default diff checklist passes.
Governance: foundation home / multiple maintainers is a criterion; avoid open-core metrics paywalls (deal breaker 3).
Household entry bar: <=3-line config + auto-ACME + single static binary; hot reload, rate limiting and metrics must exist at v1 (deal breaker 5).

First market: agent-infra builders: credential isolation (virtual keys), MCP OAuth authz, cost/audit, small memory (agentgateway 1.4 GiB RSS complaint) and clean supply chain; R-GAP-1 remains C-grade, partially supported only for this slice.
Security incidents alone do not drive switching (Rift thread: 0/101): do not count on CVE records of incumbents as a demand lever.
self_improvement: Add a source-access preflight (reddit/lobste.rs/GH Discussions) to explorer briefs; list Lemmy/Discourse/HN-Algolia/GraphQL as the working forum APIs.
Lemmy comment pagination returns duplicate pages; dedupe by comment id.
Keyword regex 'Lean' matched 'lean' (case-insensitive): use case-sensitive proper-noun matching for tool names.
novelty_gate.py was not run (time); queries logged manually to _queries.log; ~70 queries logged.

criterion_table.note: comment-level keyword hits / distinct threads; keyword coding = mention frequency, not verified buying criterion; Lemmy = top ~50 comments per post

segments.ENT: 4 HN threads 227 comments + 10 GH discussions + 8 Traefik forum + Nine blog
segments.PROBE: 3 HN threads 378 comments (PQ/formal specific; excluded from rates)

notes.access_walls: reddit old/www .json = HTTP Blocked page; WebSearch for reddit returns only mirrors (excluded per brief); lobste.rs = Anubis PoW challenge on every route (HTML+JSON+RSS); GitHub Discussions disabled on kubernetes/ingress-nginx (410). Net: zero real reddit/lobste.rs threads; substituted Lemmy c/selfhosted (federated, real), Traefik/Caddy Discourse, GitHub Discussions, HN.
notes.caveats: Keyword coding over non-random forum samples; HN/Lemmy skew to enthusiasts; agent-gateway threads are product launches (self-selected for topic); GitHub discussions median 2 comments; switching-cost numbers rare (<=5 of ~80 threads); no hours/incidents for household beyond '10-15 minutes' anecdotes.
notes.hand_coded_switch_statements: ~30 first-person switch statements (HN+Lemmy HH): config ergonomics ~10, ACME/auto-TLS/internal CA ~5, security/audit 1, product failure (nginx-unit) 1, scale/ALB 1, config-format churn 1, moved AWAY from Caddy/easy tool for features 4 (Caddy->Traefik LB/rewrites; opnsense Caddy plugin limits; authentik; Traefik->HAProxy after 2y internal fork), tunnel/zero-trust features 3.
notes.nginx_rift: CVE-2026-42945 (NVD published 2026-05-13, CVSS 9.2 v4/8.1 v3) heap overflow ngx_http_rewrite_module since 0.6.27; HN thread 48138268 (101 comments, 2026-05-14): 0 commenters stated leaving nginx; 12 comments about patch/upgrade; debate was ASLR. IngressNightmare thread 43465424 (9.8, 2025-03-24, 21c): 0 switch statements. => security incidents do not trigger switching by themselves in this sample.
dealbreakers_top5: 1. Migration non-parity: unsupported nginx annotations/snippets (whitelist-source-range, use-regex, proxy-ssl-verify, configuration-snippet) and missing auth features (kgateway lacked OIDC/basic/API-key) - appears in ~12 ENT threads (RKE2 8672, kubero 717, EG 5594, kgateway 12896, Traefik forum x6)

2. Behavioural default drift causing production incidents after a 'working' migration (Nine: 50s vs 60s timeouts -> 504, 2000 maxconn/pod, HTTP/1.0 passthrough -> 400, bcrypt spinlock; Traefik 29640 404s; 29704 dual-controller race)

3. Open-core / paywalled features and license risk (NGINX Gateway Fabric metrics Plus-only: 'we will stop using'; Bifrost gated features; GoModel licence debate; Sozu AGPL; Pingoo README complaint) - ~6 threads

4. Maintainer/governance continuity (River 'died when funding stopped' 45653865; nginx-unit archived; ingress-nginx retired; Caddy maintainership thread 45598590; Traefik issue open since 2019 -> internal fork 2y -> HAProxy)

5. Missing operational must-haves in the newcomer: hot/graceful config reload and dynamic backends, rate-limit/geo modules, metrics, sendfile/perf doubts, distro packaging and curl|bash install distrust (Ferron thread 45653350, nginx ACME 44889941, Caddy 43070025). Also benchmark-credibility backlash (Ferron charts, GoModel) in 2 threads.
notes.who_switches_first: Hypothesis H-W1 (grade C/D): first-adopter segments in order (a) forced ingress-nginx migrators (dated EOL; but they demand drop-in parity, not assurance: they will adopt Traefik/Envoy Gateway/HAProxy), (b) agent-infrastructure builders (YC-style startups; HN agent-gateway threads) who state credential isolation, authz/OAuth for MCP, cost/audit, distrust of LiteLLM-class supply-chain/quality - the only segment where agent hardening is a stated criterion; (c) household/Docker self-hosters switch only for config ergonomics + auto-ACME (Caddy/Traefik/Pangolin) - a new server must be <=3-line config with auto-TLS to even enter. Formal assurance, PQ, FIPS: no segment states them. Implication for R-GAP-1: demand evidence supports the unserved combination only for the agent-gateway slice; for ingress/household the gating criteria are migration parity, ergonomics, governance; differentiators should be positioned as invisible defaults, not selling points.
